design_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Swiss typography precision with warm editorial paper texture and quiet modern AI indicators
Emotion First: Writing is intimate; UI must never interrupt state of flow or feel like noisy AI popups
Content is King: The user's words and metrics take 90% of visual weight
Negative Space: Generous breathing room around writing stats, suggestions, and memory controls
Contrast & Legibility: Stark high contrast text against subtle warm stone / obsidian backgrounds

fonts.sans: Geist Variable, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.heading: Geist Variable, sans-serif
fonts.mono: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace

scale_and_limits.h1_hero: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight (MAX text-5xl)

typesetting_rules: MUST use tight tracking (tracking-tight) for headlines > 24px
Overlines / Labels MUST be Uppercase + Tiny (text-xs) + Wide Spacing (tracking-[0.15em] or tracking-widest)
Hierarchy gap rule: Jump between headline and subtitle must not exceed 2 Tailwind scale steps
BANNED for headings: Generic Inter, Arial, or over-saturated gradient typography

rules: NO full-screen heavy gradients or bright neon background fills
Tinted greys rule: Avoid pure black/grey; rely on subtle oklch tones with 1px precise borders
Contrast compliance: Ensure normal text has min 4.5:1 ratio (WCAG AA / APCA standards)
Hover text color MUST be explicitly defined (e.g. hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground)

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid var(--border) with rounded-lg or rounded-xl (max radius 0.625rem)
visual_enhancers.shadows: Subtle ambient layers (shadow-sm or shadow-md for popovers/dropdowns). Avoid heavy glow or muddy neumorphism
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used ONLY for sticky floating bars or side sheets (backdrop-blur-md bg-background/80 border border-border/50)
visual_enhancers.textures: Clean minimal surface with optional 1% opacity paper grain or noise overlay for editorial feel
anti_patterns: NO transparent dropdown menu or dialog backgrounds
NO floating center-everything layouts for dense text views
NO AI assistant emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡🔮) used as UI icons

extension_popup_constraints.layout: Flex column or tight single-column list with fixed sticky header and footer CTA
extension_popup_constraints.padding: p-4 or p-5 with tight gap-3

dashboard_grid_structure.base: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6

grids_and_layouts.alignment_rules: Left-align all content, labels, inputs, and paragraphs. Optical alignment for buttons with icons (extra 2px padding).

customizations.tabs: Override default fixed height 'h-9' with 'h-auto p-1' to avoid text truncation in tab headers
customizations.cards: Use flat cards with 1px border-border, bg-card, p-4 or p-6 internal padding
customizations.buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp rounded-md with transition-colors and active scale micro-feedback
customizations.dropdowns: MUST have solid bg-popover and border border-border with z-50 to prevent content transparency bleed
customizations.sonner_toasts: Positioned top-right or bottom-right with high contrast bg-card text-foreground border border-border

micro_interactions: Smooth height/opacity transitions for AI suggestion expandable drawers
Subtle active press scale effect (active:scale-[0.98]) on primary action buttons
Staggered entrance opacity fade for document chunk/memory list items
motion_and_interactions.accessibility: Respect prefers-reduced-motion; disable spatial movement transforms when active

image_urls.description: Gold ballpoint pen on notebook, minimalist editorial writing focus
image_urls.usage: Use as background or visual thumbnail for writing onboarding and editorial profile card

image_urls.description: Person writing on journal book with pen and coffee
image_urls.usage: Use for document memory showcase and active session preview banner

image_urls.description: Black pen on white notebook, top down clean view
image_urls.usage: Use in writing session history or prompt library preview empty state

ai_experience_guidelines.offline_safety: Show visible 'Offline / Local Fallback' status badge when AI backend or API provider is unreachable
ai_experience_guidelines.suggestions_flow: Contextual cards with clear action buttons (Accept, Dismiss, Copy, Save to Memory)
ai_experience_guidelines.memory_management: User-scoped list of saved writing goals, style preferences, tone rules, and document metadata chunks
ai_experience_guidelines.privacy_indicators: Clear labels indicating data stored locally in chrome.storage vs synced to user-scoped FastAPI backend

instructions_to_main_agent: Phase 1 focus: Preserve existing word-counting, sessions, progress, static prompt library, and extension behavior.
Do NOT redesign or alter the existing Chrome Extension popup flow unless specifically requested.
Implement the backend scaffolding in FastAPI (Pydantic v2 models for AI profile, onboarding answers, doc metadata/chunks, memory, suggestions, usage tracking) and Mongo collections with async motor.
Add authenticated user-scoped API boundary under /api with configurable LLM provider interface and graceful mock/fallback.
Use data-testid on all interactive buttons, inputs, tabs, modal triggers, and memory items for Playwright testability.
Keep frontend types synchronized with backend Pydantic models in TS strict mode.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive and key status display elements MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format (e.g. data-testid='ai-onboarding-submit-button')
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.no_ai_slop: Avoid generic centered layouts, default un-styled cards, and gradient text overload.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.spacing_rule: Use generous padding inside bordered containers (p-4 to p-8) to prevent text touch/collision.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.transition_rule: NEVER use 'transition: all'. Apply target properties like transition-colors, transition-opacity, or transition-transform.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.toast_rule: Use sonner for notifications via import { toast } from 'sonner'.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.theme_support: Ensure both light and dark mode classes (.dark) work seamlessly without broken low-contrast states.
